name: Task flow
description: How work moves through its stages, and when it gets done.
long_description:
A flow view of the initiative's work: the funnel from the widest stage to the narrowest, the same counts as a chart, and a calendar grid of day-by-day activity.

Useful for spotting where work piles up rather than for tracking any one task.
release_notes: Counts only live work: archived tasks, and tasks in template projects, no longer reach the stages, the figures or the pace.

binding.sql: SELECT s.category AS stage, count(*) AS tasks FROM tasks t JOIN task_statuses s ON t.task_status_id = s.id WHERE t.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false GROUP BY s.category
SELECT title, project.name AS project, due_date FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false ORDER BY tasks.created_at LIMIT 12
SELECT count(*) AS overdue FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NULL AND due_date < now() AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false
SELECT count(*) AS finished FROM tasks WHERE completed_at >= now() - CAST('30 days' AS interval) AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false

SELECT date_trunc('day', tasks.completed_at) AS day, count(*) AS finished FROM tasks WHERE completed_at IS NOT NULL AND tasks.archived_at IS NULL AND project.is_template = false GROUP BY date_trunc('day', tasks.completed_at) ORDER BY date_trunc('day', tasks.completed_at)
